title: Goodbye Michael
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Goodbye Michael,' Michael prepares to leave Dunder Mifflin for Colorado, saying emotional farewells to colleagues and reflecting on his time at the office. The episode features conflicts, humorous moments, and heartfelt goodbyes as Michael transitions to a new chapter in his life.
